K N CHOUDHURY, MR. M AHMED,MR. D J DAS Advocate for the Respondent : SC, HEALTH, SC, FINANCE  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NELSON SAILO  ORDER 04.12.2024 The instructions received by Mr. B. Gogoi, learned counsel for the Health Department is that the service of the petitioner was extended only till 14.11.2023 and therefore, according to the Department, the petitioner is no longer in service. 
On the other hand, Mr. K.N. Choudhury, learned Senior Counsel submits that although an attempt was made by the relievers to join the post occupied by the petitioner, the Joint Director of Health Services has informed the Commissioner and Secretary, Government of Assam, Health and Family Welfare Department that there is no vacant post for the reliever to join since the petitioner is holding the post. 
Considering the submissions made today, the learned counsel for the rival Page No.# 3/3 parties shall file their instructions and additional affidavit within a period of a week.
